attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) to permit and log TCP/23 traffic from node3 to node4, and node2 (OPNsense) to reject and log the same flow, using a forced next-hop chain (node3 -> node1 -> node2) since all four nodes share one flat /24 with a single NIC each. Verified with a live attempt from node3 that produces a correlated pair of log entries (matching IP-ID/source-port) showing the SYN packet permitted at node1 and refused at node2, proving that is where the traffic stops. All four nodes were then restarted one at a time via native reboot, boot identity change confirmed on each, and node1/node2 firewall configuration was proven to persist across reboot; the demo was re-run post-restart producing a fresh matching log pair.
